title: Two men at the door explain the implant and say Raudive invented it

tellings.quote: then uh he says it was invented by a man named Constantine Raw. And they leave.

plain: The author Whitley Strieber, who says he has met aliens, says that in 2025 two men came to the door of his California apartment, explained an implant to him, and said it had been invented by a man named Konstantin Raudive, then left. Strieber tells Michels this as something that happened to him: "he says it was invented by a man named Constantine Raw. And they leave." If true, it would mean strangers knew about the implant and its origin and came to tell him.
